data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been supplemented by GBP 9.3m (2014: GBP 1.1m) favourable development from prior years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a favourable prior-year development of GBP 9.3m for 2015 (2014: GBP 1.1m), which the report attributes to favourable claims development and reduced frequency/severity in prior years. This prior year release equates to roughly a 10% reduction on the opening gross claims outstanding balance. No detailed gross movement note was identified in the available images; the quantified figure used is taken from the Managing Agent's narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: supplemented by GBP 9.3m (2014: GBP 1.1m) favourable development from prior years
reduction in the frequency and severity
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves derived from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior year comparative column but exact label/row reading was partially obscured in the images (inferred 2014 closing = 93.308m). Prior year development figure (GBP 9.3m favourable) was taken from the Managing Agent's narrative (page 2) and appears to be a net/focused narrative figure; no clear separate 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column was legible in the extracted pages. Gross premium total taken from the Technical Account table (page 16) which is denominated in GBP 000s (converted to millions). The claims development triangle is present but numeric cells were not reliably extractable from the images; as a result the prior-year movement uses the narrative figure (NET) rather than a corroborating gross movement note. Users should treat the prior_year_development_gbp_m as NET-based and the opening_reserves as an inferred read from the Balance Sheet image.
